name: Anime Friends
blurb: One of the world's largest anime conventions, filling Distrito Anhembi in Sao Paulo with anime, cosplay, an artist's alley and music festival stages.

editions.evidence: Homepage (a post-AF26 'obrigado'/thank-you page) text: '01, 02, 03 E 04 JULHO DE 2027 DISTRITO ANHEMBI - SAO PAULO'; corroborated by press coverage (Omelete, JWave, The Seriuz News, Universo Japanese Music, all reporting 'Anime Friends 2027 ... 1, 2, 3 e 4 de julho' at Distrito Anhembi) and the organizer's own X/Twitter post announcing the same dates.

notes: Types inferred from the brand (anime convention with a long-running artist's alley, cosplay and, per coverage, a returning 'Bandai Namco Music Live Festival' stage) rather than stated on-site, since the current homepage is just a thank-you page for the just-finished AF26 edition. All on-page nav links (Atracoes AF26, Programacao AF26, Artist's Alley, Meet and Greet) still point at AF26 content; press coverage confirms AF27's guest/artist lineup has not been announced yet beyond the music festival's return as a program element (not an individual guest), so guests=none-yet. Cover uses the Anime Friends logo (the og:image), the only on-brand asset available before AF27's own key art is published; the homepage also carries a sponsor-strip image which was avoided per the cover rules.
